meta.title: LA-MC-ICP-MS Spot Registration
cite: At. Spectrosc. 43 · Rb–Sr, lunar meteorite silicates
CUG Wuhan · NWR FemtoUC + Neptune Plus
meta.foot: Mockup generated from LA-MC-ICPMS_TAPP_v77 — 125 procedure-level fields across 6 groups. The form is set to Spot mode as requested, but the library's only LA-MC-ICP-MS literature assessment (Zhang et al. 2022) is a Transect procedure, so fields that do not apply to Spot are marked rather than silently carried. Values are an example of a filled form, not a registered procedure.
